entities.name: Caliphear
entities.description: Black horse with a flaming mane and tail from Corondor, known as Caliphear the Nightmare.

entities.name: Jamil
entities.description: Wizard who summoned Caliphear to destroy Nevar.

entities.name: Nevar
entities.description: Wizard Caliphear was summoned to destroy on another plane.

entities.name: Altair of Coloni
entities.description: Helped defeat Coldraith and pledged to be Caliphear's slave for ten years.

entities.name: Coldraith
entities.description: Wizard who ruined the Great Salt Marshes and the Plains of Coloni; defeated.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Companion in the quest to destroy Ravidel.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Companion in the quest to destroy Ravidel.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Wizard who unsummoned Caliphear during the battle at the Dueling Chasm.

entities.name: Dueling Chasm of Golthonor
entities.description: Site of the battle where Caliphear was unsummoned.

events.summary: Jamil summons Caliphear to destroy the wizard Nevar on another plane.
events.quote: she was summoned by the wizard Jamil to destroy the wizard Nevar on another plane

events.summary: Caliphear and Altair of Coloni defeat Coldraith; Altair pledges to be her slave for ten years.
events.quote: Altair pledged to be her slave for ten years in payment for her help in destroying Coldraith

events.summary: Caliphear joins Kristina of the Woods and Jared Carthalion in their quest to destroy Ravidel.
events.quote: She joined Kristina of the Woods and Jared Carthalion in their quest to destroy Ravidel

events.summary: Ravidel unsummons Caliphear to an unknown location during the battle at the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
events.quote: Caliphear was unsummoned by Ravidel to an unknown location

relations.note: Pledged to be her slave for ten years.
relations.quote: Altair pledged to be her slave for ten years
